pricing.faq1Q: What is the difference between Community and Commercial editions?
pricing.faq1A: The Community Edition provides full model-driven low-code framework capabilities, free forever. Commercial editions (Seed and above) additionally offer commercial deployment licenses, enterprise features (multi-database support, advanced permissions, data visualization, etc.), and dedicated technical support.
pricing.faq2Q: How do I get my license after purchase?
pricing.faq2A: After completing an online purchase, you will receive an email containing your license key. Follow the documentation to activate it and start using the platform. Enterprise customers receive dedicated account manager assistance for deployment and license configuration.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
pricing.faq3A: You can upgrade anytime — just pay the price difference. Downgrades take effect after the current subscription period ends. All data and configurations are fully preserved during upgrades, with no redeployment needed.
pricing.faq4A: A development license permits a developer to build applications on the Oinone platform. Each team member participating in development needs one license seat. End users of deployed applications do not require additional licenses, and there is no limit on end-user count.
pricing.faq5A: All commercial purchases include VAT special invoices or standard invoices. After completing your purchase, you can request an invoice through the order management page, typically issued within 3-5 business days.
pricing.faq6Q: Do end users need to pay after deployment?
pricing.faq6A: No. Oinone does not limit end-user count, application count, or data volume. You only need to purchase development licenses for your development team — deployed applications can serve unlimited users.

about.label: About Us
about.storyOpening: Hey there! 👋 We are Shushi, founded in 2019, a company dedicated to bringing revolutionary experiences to developers, software companies, and enterprise R&D teams in the enterprise software space.
about.storyP1: We are an elite team of top technical experts and AI enthusiasts, committed to revolutionizing enterprise software development infrastructure. We are not just developers — we are explorers who dare to break traditions, deeply explore AI, and shape the future of enterprise software development.
about.storyP2: Our team is a diverse fusion of technology innovators, united by our shared vision of transforming enterprise software, our passion for innovation, and our firm belief in unleashing the potential of enterprise software through AI.
about.storyHighlight: Shushi Oinone is an AI-powered low-code framework positioned as infrastructure for enterprise software development. 'O' stands for Open Source, and the brand sounds like 'All-In-One'. While traditional low-code platforms solve 'how to build fast', Oinone focuses on answering 'how to build well'. To date, Oinone has been validated in core business scenarios of many Fortune 500 and industry-leading enterprises, attracting over 100 software partners, with use cases spanning government, manufacturing, retail, automotive, education, defense, healthcare, energy, and more.
about.storyClosing: In the AI era, with us by your side, let's explore the next generation of enterprise software together. 🚀
